messages:
deploy-bot: starting rollout rl-2026-03-23-19 canary=12% -> scheduled step to 40% in 10m
anya: spotting p95 bump on gateway probes in eu-west, baseline ~140ms now ~230ms :frowning:
sam: pulling gw logs, will check auth path metrics
matt: seeing auth_header_kv miss rate spike on gw-prod-3: 0.07 -> baseline 0.01, tail latency aligns
lucy: release notes only list routing.hint_prefer_local toggle and small proxy tweak, nothing auth-specific
anya: synth probes still 200s but slower, so healthy responses but higher latency
triage-bot: INC-2026-047 created - postdeploy synth latency anomaly
sam: proposal: pause ramp at current 12% and pin /generate to previous variant (v2.1.1) while we triage. Thoughts?
anya: +1 pause, pin makes sense
matt: agree, seems like the routing hint increased header lookup frequency causing extra KV reads 
lucy: pin call (sample):
```
POST /admin/routing/pin
{"route":"/generate","variant":"v2.1.1"}
```
sam: applied pin at 4532109932 (actor: sam) :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: routing pin applied for /generate -> v2.1.1
ops-bot: smoke-probe run -> p95=148ms p99=205ms status=ok
anya: latency back near baseline after pin, nice job
matt: leaving canary at 12% for 20m, if stable we'll resume ramp; if not, plan full rollback
sam: adding short note to changelog: "temporarily pinned /generate to v2.1.1 after spike in auth KV misses introduced by routing.hint_prefer_local; follow-up investigation in RFC-2026-77."
lucy: opened follow-up ticket to evaluate prefetching auth headers and reducing KV roundtrips (RFC-2026-77)
triage-bot: INC-2026-047 marked monitoring, awaiting stable window
anya: quick retrospective item: add a synthetic that targets auth-heavy endpoints in pre-rollout checks
matt: will add to deploy checklist, and add a tiny perf smoke hitting header paths before any routing changes roll beyond canary
sam: if all green at 4532110024 we resume ramp to 40% (manual)
anya: thanks all, keep eyes on dashboards and logs, will update thread after 20m.
